name: Jens Vestergaard
bio:
Jens's journey into motorsport started later in life, after a successful career as a mechanical engineer in the wind turbine industry. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and unwavering focus on detail led him to transition to quality control within a small Danish racing team. He quickly excelled, becoming known for his ability to identify potential issues before they escalate into costly failures. 

His pragmatic nature ensures that he always prioritizes practical solutions over theoretical ideals. Jens believes in rigorous testing and data analysis, favoring a data-driven approach to quality assurance. He's not afraid to challenge established procedures if he believes they can be improved, making him a valuable asset to any team striving for peak performance. His experience with complex machinery and his unwavering commitment to quality are what set him apart.

physical.description: Jens is a stout man with a weathered face, reflecting years of focused work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously recording observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric measurements, even when others use imperial.
